text:
anna: quick sync — we need to finalize launch buckets for the compliance epic. proposing 3 buckets: 1) SOC2-ready (30d retention, full audit export), 2) Enterprise BYO (cust-managed keys, 1y retention), 3) Lite (90d, redacted telemetry). thoughts?

matt: +1 on buckets. can we be explicit about acceptance criteria per bucket? engineers need clear gating to sign off.

tara: quick notes from security: for SOC2-ready we need: attestable evidence export, KMS integration tests, and a consented data flow doc. For BYO we need key escrow process and rotation prove-out.

ryan: customers asking for a BYO grace path — they want KMS onboarding in phases (pilot with one tenant, then org-wide). acceptance criteria should include a migration rollback plan.

anna: good call — suggest minimal acceptance checklist per bucket so QA can verify. draft below, please comment inline.

anna: ``SOC2-ready checklist (min): ["audit_export_v1 (json/ndjson)", "tenant-level retention config UI", "KMS-integrated key wrap/unwarp e2e test", "evidence manifest + hash"]``

matt: engineering notes: for `audit_export_v1` we'll stream ndjson with one event per line. minimal schema: `{"ts","tenant_id","req_id","actor","action","model","tokens_in","tokens_out","trace_id"}`. is that sufficient for security/CS?

tara: that schema is fine as a starting point but add `auth_method` and `kms_key_id` (nullable). also we need clear PII handling: `input_redaction_level` field.

ryan: for customer comms, we also need an internal FAQ and explicit SLAs for export time windows. propose 24h for on-demand exports, 30d for automated retention export.

anna: decision proposal: ship bucket MVP with SOC2-ready and Lite at launch, BYO as canary pilot (one customer) in Q3. rollback: if BYO pilot fails, customers stay on hosted keys (no data loss). who owns the canary plan?

matt: eng volunteers to own canary infra (me + 1). will sketch runbook. needs repo + test tenants.

tara: security will own threat model and key escrow checklist. I will add the acceptance tests to the security runbook.

ryan: CS will coordinate pilot customer and create comms. will add migration checklist for customers.

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-4578 "compliance buckets MVP: SOC2+Lite launch" and linked to calendar event 2026-04-10.

anna: next steps: matt to post PR with `audit_export_v1` schema, tara to add security test cases, ryan to confirm pilot customer by EOD Friday. if we agree, I'll add this to roadmap and prioritization board. :white_check_mark:

matt: putting PR up today.

tara: I'll add tests by Thurs.

ryan: confirming customer tonight.

anna: perfect — thanks all. leaving this thread open for follow-ups. :heart:
